scanNote:
6-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (40-bet) - LEAD-IN.

YUQORI YARIM: sarg'ish-krem fonda KATTA SURATLAR KOLLAJI, har biri oq yorliqli.
Chap yuqorida qora katta harflar 'UNIT 6'.
O'rtada YaShIL, soyali, bezakli harflar bilan 'Food, Glorious Food'.

SURATLAR va YoRLIQLARI (yuqoridan pastga):
 • melon - kesilgan sariq qovun bo'lagi
 • cucumber - yashil bodring
 • watermelon - kesilgan tarvuz bo'lagi
 • mushrooms - ikkita oq qo'ziqorin
 • peaches - uchta shaftoli
 • freshly-squeezed carrot juice - stakanda to'q sariq sharbat, yonida sabzilar (bargi bilan)
 • apple juke → 'apple juice' - oyoqli qadahda sariq sharbat, yonida qizil olma
 • lettuce - yashil salat bargi (karam shaklida)
 • fried chicken - oq laganda qovurilgan tovuq bo'laklari
 • lamb & mashed potatoes - laganda qo'y go'shti va ezilgan kartoshka
 • wholemeal bread - uzun jigarrang non
 • fried egg, sausages, French toast - laganda qovurilgan tuxum, kolbasa va tuxumga botirilgan non
 • grilled chicken, Basmati rice, brussels sprouts, carrots - bezakli laganda
 • fruit salad - shisha idishda rangli meva salati (kivi, uzum, banan)
 • steak, jacket potato, broccoli - oq laganda bifshteks, po'sti bilan pishirilgan kartoshka, brokkoli
 • spaghetti bolognese, garlic bread - laganda spagetti va non
 • chocolate cake - to'q jigarrang shokoladli tort
 • doughnut - glazurli ponchik
 • bacon & cheese sandwich - kesilgan sendvich
 • nuts - yong'oqlar (yerto'la)
 • bread rolls - savatda oq bulochkalar
 • yoghurt - 'Low Fat' yozuvli ko'k-oq yogurt qutisi
 • prawns - uchta pushti krevetka
 • green beans - yashil loviya qo'zoqlari
 • olive oil & vinegar - ikkita bezakli shisha
 • peas - ochilgan no'xat qo'zog'i
 • mussels - qora midiya chig'anoqlari
 • club sandwich, chips - laganda uch qavatli sendvich va kartoshka fri

PASTKI YARIM (oq-kulrang fon):
• To'q sariq sarlavha 'Lead-in'.
1) 'Look at the pictures of food and drinks. Which are: HEALTHY, LOW-FAT FOODS; FATTY FOODS; JUNK FOOD?' (qiya harflarda)
2) 'What food & drink would be suitable for: A VEGETARIAN; SOMEBODY WHO IS ON A DIET?'
3) a) 'What do you usually eat and drink: AT WORK/SCHOOL; ON A PICNIC; AT A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT; AT AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT?'
   b) 'Do you often: EAT JUNK FOOD; HAVE A SNACK BETWEEN MEALS?'
   c) 'Do you worry about how healthy your diet is? Are you a fussy eater?'
   d) 'Which foods: CONTAIN A LOT OF CALORIES; CONTAIN PROTEIN; ARE RICH IN VITAMINS?'
4) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and match the stars to the things they like to eat or drink.'
   1 Demi Moore | a bacon sandwiches
   2 Helen Hunt | b fried chicken
   3 Eddie Murphy | c watermelon (without seeds)
   4 Whoopi Goldberg | d turkey sandwiches
   5 Bill Murray | e carrot juice
   6 Mickey Rourke | f poached eggs

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '40'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks.
exercises.explanationUz:
6-UNIT LUG'ATI - OVQAT.

  ⚠ Betdagi HAMMA yorliq - keyingi
  mashqlarda kerak bo'ladi.


⚠ SANALADIGAN va SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda '-s'):
     peaches, mushrooms, nuts,
     prawns, mussels, sandwiches,
     bread rolls

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     bread, rice, juice, oil,
     vinegar, chicken (go'sht
     sifatida), lettuce

  ⚠ 'a chicken' = tirik tovuq,
  'chicken' = tovuq go'shti.


⚠ FAQAT KO'PLIKDAGI OVQATLAR:

  peas, green beans, brussels
  sprouts, chips, mussels, prawns,
  nuts


⚠ 'CHIPS' - IKKI XIL MA'NO:

  Britaniyada 'chips' = kartoshka
     fri (yumshoq, yo'g'on)
  AQShda 'chips' = kartoshka
     chipsi (yupqa, quruq)

  ⚠ Britaniyada chips uchun 'crisps'
  deyiladi!


⚠ 'A JACKET POTATO':

  = po'sti bilan pishirilgan
  kartoshka.
  ⚠ 'a baked potato' ham deyiladi.


⚠ 'WHOLEMEAL BREAD':

  = to'liq donli non.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'wholemeal',
  AQShda 'whole wheat'.


⚠ 'FRESHLY-SQUEEZED':

  = yangi siqilgan.
  ⚠ 'to squeeze' = siqmoq.
  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (ravish + sifat).


⚠ 'A DOUGHNUT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'doughnut',
  AQShda 'donut'.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈdəʊnʌt/ - 'gh'
  O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'YOGHURT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada 'yoghurt' yoki
  'yogurt', AQShda 'yogurt'.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈjɒɡət/.


⚠ 'BRUSSELS SPROUTS':

  = Bryussel karami.
  ⚠ 'Brussels' - KATTA harf (shahar
  nomi).


⚠ 'SPAGHETTI BOLOGNESE':

  ⚠ 'spaghetti' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  BIRLIK fe'l bilan:
  'Spaghetti IS my favourite.'

points.en: grilled chicken, Basmati rice, brussels sprouts, carrots
points.uz: panjarada pishirilgan tovuq, basmati guruch, Bryussel karami, sabzilar

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'cake' butun bo'lsa sanaladigan,
bo'lak bo'lsa 'a piece of cake'.

⚠ Suratdagi qutida 'Low Fat' = kam yog'li.
⚠ O'qilishi /ˈjɒɡət/.

⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.
⚠ 'peace' (tinchlik) bilan BIR XIL o'qiladi!

⚠ Britaniyada 'chips' = kartoshka FRI.
⚠ AQShda 'chips' = kartoshka ChIPSI
(Britaniyada u 'crisps').

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures of food and drinks. Which are: healthy, low-fat foods; fatty foods; junk food?
exercises.instructionUz: Ovqat va ichimliklar suratlariga qarang. Qaysilari: sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar; yog'li ovqatlar; foydasiz ovqat?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TOIFA.


⚠ 'HEALTHY, LOW-FAT FOODS':

  = sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: melon, cucumber,
  watermelon, mushrooms, peaches,
  carrot juice, apple juice,
  lettuce, fruit salad, green beans,
  peas, prawns, mussels, yoghurt
  (low fat), grilled chicken,
  wholemeal bread, broccoli


⚠ 'FATTY FOODS':

  = yog'li ovqatlar.
  Betdan: fried chicken, sausages,
  bacon, chocolate cake, doughnut,
  nuts, olive oil, French toast,
  garlic bread


⚠ 'JUNK FOOD':

  = foydasiz, tez tayyor ovqat.
  Betdan: club sandwich with chips,
  doughnut, bacon & cheese sandwich


⚠ 'FOOD' - SANALMAYDIGAN:

  ⚠ 'Food IS expensive.' (BIRLIK
  fe'l)
  ⚠ Lekin 'foods' = turli xil
  ovqatlar (turlar haqida
  gapirganda) - mashqda ham shunday.


⚠ 'JUNK':

  = axlat, keraksiz narsa.
  ⚠ 'junk food' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  'junk foods' XATO.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FAT':

  fat = semiz (odam) yoki yog' (ot)
  fatty = yog'li (ovqat)

  ⚠ 'a fat food' - XATO,
  'a fatty food' ✓


⚠ 'LOW-FAT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'full-fat' yoki 'high-fat'.

items.en: Which foods are healthy, low-fat foods?
items.uz: Qaysi ovqatlar sog'lom va kam yog'li?
items.answerEn: Melon, cucumber, watermelon, peaches, fruit salad, lettuce, green beans, peas, prawns, mussels, low-fat yoghurt, grilled chicken, carrot juice and apple juice are healthy, low-fat foods.
items.answerUz: Qovun, bodring, tarvuz, shaftoli, meva salati, salat bargi, yashil loviya, no'xat, krevetka, midiya, kam yog'li yogurt, panjarada pishirilgan tovuq, sabzi va olma sharbati sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqatlardir.

items.answerEn: Fried chicken, sausages, bacon, chocolate cake, doughnuts, nuts, French toast and garlic bread are fatty foods.
items.answerUz: Qovurilgan tovuq, kolbasa, bekon, shokoladli tort, ponchik, yong'oq, frantsuz tosti va sarimsoqli non yog'li ovqatlardir.

items.answerEn: The club sandwich with chips, the doughnut and the bacon & cheese sandwich are junk food.
items.answerUz: Kartoshka fri bilan klub-sendvich, ponchik va bekon-pishloqli sendvich foydasiz ovqatdir.

exercises.instructionEn: What food & drink would be suitable for: a vegetarian; somebody who is on a diet?
exercises.instructionUz: Qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi: vegetarianga; parhezdagi odamga?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'A VEGETARIAN':

  = go'sht yemaydigan odam.
  ⚠ Lekin tuxum, sut, pishloq yeydi.
  ⚠ 'a vegan' = umuman hayvon
  mahsulotlarini yemaydigan.


⚠ 'TO BE ON A DIET':

  = parhezda bo'lmoq (ozish uchun).
  ⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi
  ShART.
  ⚠ 'to go on a diet' = parhezga
  o'tirmoq.


⚠ 'A DIET' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) parhez (ozish uchun)
  2) ovqatlanish tarzi (umuman)
     'a healthy diet' = sog'lom
     ovqatlanish

  ⚠ 3c mashqida IKKINChI ma'noda.


⚠ 'SUITABLE FOR':

  = ... uchun mos.
  ⚠ 'suitable TO' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to suit' = mos kelmoq.

items.en: What food & drink would be suitable for a vegetarian?
items.uz: Vegetarianga qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi?
items.answerEn: Fruit salad, lettuce, cucumber, mushrooms, peas, green beans, wholemeal bread, yoghurt, nuts and fruit juices would be suitable for a vegetarian.
items.answerUz: Meva salati, salat bargi, bodring, qo'ziqorin, no'xat, yashil loviya, to'liq donli non, yogurt, yong'oq va meva sharbatlari vegetarianga mos keladi.

items.en: What food & drink would be suitable for somebody who is on a diet?
items.uz: Parhezdagi odamga qanday ovqat va ichimlik mos keladi?
items.answerEn: Grilled chicken, prawns, mussels, green beans, broccoli, low-fat yoghurt, fresh fruit and freshly-squeezed juice would be suitable for somebody who is on a diet.
items.answerUz: Panjarada pishirilgan tovuq, krevetka, midiya, yashil loviya, brokkoli, kam yog'li yogurt, yangi meva va yangi siqilgan sharbat parhezdagi odamga mos keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: a) What do you usually eat and drink: at work/school; on a picnic; at a fast-food restaurant; at an expensive restaurant? b) Do you often: eat junk food; have a snack between meals? c) Do you worry about how healthy your diet is? Are you a fussy eater? d) Which foods: contain a lot of calories; contain protein; are rich in vitamins?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Odatda nima yeb-ichasiz: ishda/maktabda; piknikda; tez ovqat restoranida; qimmat restoranda? b) Tez-tez: foydasiz ovqat yeysizmi; ovqatlar orasida tamaddi qilasizmi? c) Ovqatlanishingiz qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotirdamisiz? Injiq yeguvchimisiz? d) Qaysi ovqatlarda: ko'p kaloriya bor; oqsil bor; vitaminlarga boy?
exercises.explanationUz:
SUHBAT SAVOLLARI.


⚠ 'AT WORK' va 'AT SCHOOL':

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! Chunki MAQSAD ko'zda
  tutilyapti (ishlash, o'qish).
  ⚠ 37-38-betlarda 'at university'
  ham shunday edi.


⚠ 'ON A PICNIC':

  ⚠ 'on' predlogi - 38-betdagi
  23-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A FAST-FOOD RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan (sifat vazifasida).
  ⚠ 'fast food' (ot) - defissiz.


⚠ 'AN EXPENSIVE RESTAURANT':

  ⚠ 'AN' - chunki 'expensive' UNLI
  bilan boshlanadi.


⚠ 'A SNACK BETWEEN MEALS':

  = ovqatlar orasida yengil tamaddi.
  ⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish
  (nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat).
  ⚠ 36-betdagi 14-mashqda 'have a
  snack' bor edi.


⚠ 'A FUSSY EATER':

  = injiq yeguvchi (ko'p narsani
  yemaydigan).
  ⚠ 'fussy' = injiq, tanlab
  yeydigan.


⚠ 'TO CONTAIN':

  = o'z ichiga olmoq, tarkibida
  bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.


⚠ 'RICH IN':

  = ... ga boy.
  ⚠ 'rich IN vitamins' - 'in'
  predlogi ShART.
  ⚠ 'rich of' - XATO.


⚠ 'CALORIES', 'PROTEIN', 'VITAMINS':

  ⚠ 'a calorie' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'protein' - SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a vitamin' - SANALADIGAN.
  ⚠ 'vitamin' Britaniyada /ˈvɪtəmɪn/,
  AQShda /ˈvaɪtəmɪn/.

items.en: a) What do you usually eat and drink at work/school?
items.answerEn: At school I usually have a sandwich and some fruit juice.
items.answerUz: Maktabda odatda sendvich va meva sharbati ichaman.

items.en: a) What do you usually eat and drink on a picnic?
items.answerEn: On a picnic we usually have bread rolls, fried chicken, fruit salad and cold drinks.
items.answerUz: Piknikda odatda bulochka, qovurilgan tovuq, meva salati va sovuq ichimliklar bo'ladi.

items.en: a) What do you usually eat at a fast-food restaurant?
items.uz: a) Tez ovqat restoranida odatda nima yeysiz?
items.answerEn: At a fast-food restaurant I usually have a club sandwich and chips.
items.answerUz: Tez ovqat restoranida odatda klub-sendvich va kartoshka fri olaman.

items.en: a) What do you usually eat at an expensive restaurant?
items.uz: a) Qimmat restoranda odatda nima yeysiz?
items.answerEn: At an expensive restaurant I usually have steak with a jacket potato and broccoli.
items.answerUz: Qimmat restoranda odatda bifshteks, po'sti bilan kartoshka va brokkoli olaman.

items.en: b) Do you often eat junk food or have a snack between meals?
items.uz: b) Tez-tez foydasiz ovqat yeysizmi yoki ovqatlar orasida tamaddi qilasizmi?
items.answerEn: No, I don't often eat junk food, but I sometimes have a snack between meals.
items.answerUz: Yo'q, foydasiz ovqatni tez-tez yemayman, lekin ba'zan ovqatlar orasida tamaddi qilaman.

items.en: c) Do you worry about how healthy your diet is? Are you a fussy eater?
items.uz: c) Ovqatlanishingiz qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotirdamisiz? Injiq yeguvchimisiz?
items.answerEn: Yes, I worry about my diet a little. No, I'm not a fussy eater — I eat almost everything.
items.answerUz: Ha, ovqatlanishimdan biroz xavotirdaman. Yo'q, injiq yeguvchi emasman - deyarli hamma narsani yeyman.

items.en: d) Which foods contain a lot of calories?
items.uz: d) Qaysi ovqatlarda ko'p kaloriya bor?
items.answerEn: Chocolate cake, doughnuts, fried chicken, chips and nuts contain a lot of calories.
items.answerUz: Shokoladli tort, ponchik, qovurilgan tovuq, kartoshka fri va yong'oqda ko'p kaloriya bor.

items.answerEn: Chicken, steak, lamb, prawns, mussels, eggs, cheese, yoghurt and nuts contain protein.
items.answerUz: Tovuq, bifshteks, qo'y go'shti, krevetka, midiya, tuxum, pishloq, yogurt va yong'oqda oqsil bor.

items.en: d) Which foods are rich in vitamins?
items.answerEn: Fruit and vegetables — melon, watermelon, peaches, carrots, lettuce, broccoli and green beans — are rich in vitamins.
items.answerUz: Meva va sabzavotlar - qovun, tarvuz, shaftoli, sabzi, salat bargi, brokkoli va yashil loviya - vitaminlarga boy.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and match the stars to the things they like to eat or drink.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va yulduzlarni ular yeyishni yoki ichishni yoqtiradigan narsalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - kim nimani
yoqtirishini faqat yozuvni tinglab
bilish mumkin.


OLTI YuLDUZ:

  1 Demi Moore
  2 Helen Hunt
  3 Eddie Murphy
  4 Whoopi Goldberg
  5 Bill Murray
  6 Mickey Rourke


OLTI OVQAT:

  a bacon sandwiches
    - bekonli sendvichlar
  b fried chicken
    - qovurilgan tovuq
  c watermelon (without seeds)
    - tarvuz (urug'siz)
  d turkey sandwiches
    - kurka go'shtli sendvichlar
  e carrot juice
    - sabzi sharbati
  f poached eggs
    - qaynoq suvda pishirilgan tuxum


⚠ 'A STAR':

  = mashhur odam (kino, sport).
  ⚠ 'a film star', 'a pop star'.


⚠ 'A SEED':

  = urug', danak.
  ⚠ 'without seeds' = urug'siz.


⚠ 'A POACHED EGG':

  = qaynoq suvga po'stsiz solib
  pishirilgan tuxum.
  ⚠ Tuxum pishirish usullari:
     boiled - qaynatilgan (po'sti
        bilan)
     fried - qovurilgan
     scrambled - aralashtirilgan
     poached - suvda pishirilgan


⚠ 'TURKEY':

  = kurka (qush).
  ⚠ 'Turkey' KATTA harf bilan =
  Turkiya!


⚠ 'TO LIKE' + TO / -ING:

  'like to eat' va 'like eating' -
  ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ Britaniyada -ING ko'proq.

points.noteUz:
⚠ Audio kerak - qaysi ovqatga mosligini yozuv
aytadi.

⚠ 'to poach' = po'stsiz qaynoq suvda pishirmoq.
⚠ Boshqa usullar: boiled, fried, scrambled.

patterns.exampleEn: Fruit salad is a healthy, low-fat food.
patterns.exampleUz: Meva salati - sog'lom, kam yog'li ovqat.

patterns.exampleEn: Fruit salad would be suitable for a vegetarian.
At school I usually have a sandwich and some fruit juice.
patterns.exampleUz: Maktabda odatda sendvich va meva sharbati olaman.

patterns.exampleEn: Chocolate cake contains a lot of calories.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to contain' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'a lot of' - sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
bilan ham.

groups.explanationUz: Betdagi ko'p ovqat nomi ikki otdan yasalgan.
